features.description: Named agents are persisted with slug, display name, description, enabled, status, last run; Hermes Orchestrator plus starter specialist agents seeded, including Pokemon Vending Lead Scout
acceptance: migration 0006 creates agent_registry
hermes-orchestrator, portable-charging-lead-scout, pokemon-vending-lead-scout, portable-charging-outreach-sender, deliverability-monitor, rathworkspace-platform-developer seeded
current_status defaults to idle

features.description: Agent runs are persisted with status, trigger, timestamps, and summary
acceptance: agent_runs table exists with status/trigger/started_at/finished_at/summary
rows can be inserted via the CLI
finished_at is set when status is completed or failed

features.description: Per-run timeline events are persisted (ts, kind, status, level, summary, detail)
acceptance: agent_run_events table exists
events insert under a run and are queryable in time order

features.description: Artifacts (spreadsheet, review email id, draft packet, run log, blockers) are persisted per run
acceptance: agent_artifacts table exists
an artifact row can be attached via the CLI and read back

features.description: lib/agents.ts provides one write path (recordAgentEvent) and one read model (agentsOrchestrationSnapshot) shared by the CLI, API, and scheduler
acceptance: recordAgentEvent upserts registry+run, inserts event, updates status, mirrors meaningful events to the ticker
agentsOrchestrationSnapshot returns agents + activeRuns + recentRuns + recentEvents
API route and scheduler both call the shared builder

features.description: scripts/agent-event.ts emits a run/event/artifact from bash, SQLite-only, no internet or browser
acceptance: the mission example command shape runs and inserts a row
invalid input (missing required flag or bad status) exits non-zero
writes the same DB the app reads

features.description: GET /api/agents/runs returns the orchestration snapshot behind the auth gate
acceptance: returns 401 without an allowlisted session
returns named agents + runs + events when authenticated
existing /api/agents is unchanged

features.description: The scheduler (the only poller) reads the orchestration tables and broadcasts the agent_runs channel + mirrors new ticker events
acceptance: tickAgentRuns broadcasts agent_runs on an interval
new run events appear on the bottom ticker
the existing agents channel payload is unchanged

features.description: /agents shows named agent flows (status, latest summary, last run, timeline, artifacts) while preserving the Hermes/Telegram/Claude rows
acceptance: AgentRunsPanel renders a card per named agent with status + latest summary + last run time
a run timeline and artifacts are viewable
existing Hermes/Telegram/Claude rows and activity feed remain
responsive shell not broken (single column on mobile)

features.description: Portable Charging lead-scout can emit lifecycle events via a documented wrapper; no emails sent, no Hermes cron mutated
acceptance: scripts/pc-lead-scout.sh emits the full lifecycle (started -> spreadsheet -> leads -> drafts -> review packet -> waiting -> completed/failed)
a --demo run populates the dashboard without sending email
docs/agent-orchestration.md documents the exact event calls for Hermes cron

features.description: A Claude Code run can ask Hermes for mid-session advisory feedback, used at the two required checkpoints (max 2 calls)
acceptance: scripts/hermes-advisory.sh wraps hermes chat -q with a fallback
checkpoint 1 (after plan) and checkpoint 2 (before email) ran and were logged
no recursion beyond two calls

features.description: Pokemon Vending Lead Scout is registered, documented, and wired to emit dashboard events from the pokemon-scout Hermes profile
acceptance: migration 0008 registers pokemon-vending-lead-scout
agents/pokemon-vending-lead-scout/AGENTS.md documents scope, safety rules, and event milestones
profile worker prompt and dispatcher point to the dedicated pokemon-scout profile
agent_event.sh can emit a smoke event to the dashboard without contacting venues

features.description: Each named agent has a real AGENTS.md manifest/context, and the platform developer plus business scouts have durable Hermes skills/profile prompts
acceptance: repo root AGENTS.md exists
agents/<slug>/AGENTS.md exists for every registered named agent
Hermes skill rathworkspace-platform-developer exists and references the platform developer manifest
Pokemon Vending Lead Scout manifest and profile prompt exist under agents/pokemon-vending-lead-scout

features.description: A completion email is sent to operator@example.com from operator@example.com (or a fallback file is written)
acceptance: email summarizes agents, dashboard surfaces, scripts/hooks, how to trigger a test run, verification results, remaining work
sent via gws-arjun OR body written to AGENT_ORCHESTRATION_COMPLETION_EMAIL.txt with the failure noted
